description: This file is a Python script that performs real-time object detection on a video file using the ImageAI library, and visualizes the detection results with matplotlib.

classes.name: VideoObjectDetection
classes.description: A class from the imageai.Detection module used for setting up and running object detection on videos.

methods.name: forSecond
methods.description: A callback function invoked per second during video detection to visualize detection results with pie charts and frames.
